The pristine source is commit 7946cfa0d3775e958616d4d107de867a4616ae6c, tree db2760ffc97b9c20ef8777fcb7689082be66bc45, with no submodules. SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH 1780486798 binds the pinned commit time. The vice-x64-mixed-language-v1 contract proves exactly 564 native-version compiles (536 C and 28 C++), their exact semantic and ABI-specific invocation digests, no diagnostic lines, and the exact ordered link; parallel command-line ordering is compared as a fail-closed line multiset rather than as one incidental scheduler order.

Resolver metadata declares GPLv2, display version 3.9, supports_no_game=true, needs_fullpath=true, disk control, serialized savestates, and libretro saves. The artifacts identify VICE x64 version 3.10 7946cfa0d3 and reproducibly embed build date 'Jun  3 2026' and time '11:39:58'. No source-license capture is present, so this record makes no broader source-license claim; public distribution or release remains a human legal and policy gate, and the metadata/runtime version discrepancy remains an integration gate.

Base ROMs are embedded. Four optional JiffyDOS replacements are declared but not packaged: vice/JiffyDOS_C64.bin, vice/JiffyDOS_1541-II.bin, vice/JiffyDOS_1571_repl310654.bin, and vice/JiffyDOS_1581.bin. This evidence establishes no firmware redistribution rights. Built-in versus replacement firmware behavior and firmware discovery remain target-runtime gates.

No-game startup, full-path content loading, C64 programs, cartridges, archives and playlists, disk and tape handling, disk-control operations, controller and keyboard behavior, save disks and libretro saves, serialized save states, audio and video pacing, frontend integration, compatibility, and sustained performance remain target-runtime gates.
